roundShape: Full round: merge 3760e51c resolves runtime conflicts with main's #2508 (outbox/publisher.go, outbox/batch.go, internal/bus/async.go, confirm.go, nats.go, recovery.go, cmd/dispatch/main.go), then fix 14170450.
ci: At 14170450 only pr-title had a result when read (lint, typecheck, test and the long suites queued since 12:30Z). A request for changes does not wait on CI.
thermonuclear: thermonuclear-deep-review and thermonuclear-code-quality ran at 14170450; both request changes on the finding below.

keyFindings.description: A window Request never reads #2508's per-subject denial record: its flush finds a denial only through conn.LastError() (confirmPublished -> publishDenial, confirm.go:132-162), one slot per connection, so when another violation lands between a Request's publish and the read, a denied role forward comes back errPublishUnconfirmed, waits out roleReceiptTimeout, ends ErrNotAcknowledged, is counted reason="failed" (batch.go:541-545) and backs off with a publish_error naming another subject's violation. The merge comment says a Request reaches the record; it does not. DeepReview15's scratch probe: 8 concurrent denied Requests on one window, 1 of 8 answered ErrPublishDenied in 3 of 3 runs (2-3 under -race); with sentAt taken before PublishMsg (async.go:355) and deniedPublish(subject, sentAt) read on the request goroutine both when the flush comes back unconfirmed and in the timer arm, 8 of 8. Fix that way, with a several-Requests test.

Role-forward outcomes that are not NATS failures are counted reason="failed": a route held pending by forward.err (stale holder, kept claim, churned claim, failed read) and a holder that sent no receipt after a confirmed flush. The metric's HELP (cmd/dispatch/main.go:431) and docs say failed means the send did not reach NATS, so a stale holder reads as an outage on every retry. Give them their own reason, or say so in the HELP and docs; settle after the finding above.

judgement: Events held behind a denied head with no attempt or log line of their own: no finding. Nothing is lost (main never delivered the denied subject either and retried forever; the branch delivers the head and then its followers in order once the grant returns, where main's build delivered comment 1 after 2-5). The head logs slog.Error "dispatch outbox: publish event" on every attempt, naming the denied subject, which is what INFRA-749's filter matches; held events carry the head's next_attempt_at. One stall main lacked: an owner's notifications.dispatch.* subjects share one key, so a hand-written grant denying one event type of the family holds the others; every shipped grant allows notifications.>.
verifiedCorrect: quiet in every envelope: envelope() is the only builder; retries and role forwards reuse it.
Every settled send counted once in settle: refused, denied, failed (ErrUnavailable included); fenced and ctx-cut sends count nothing; held sends are never issued.

The window's acknowledged reads deniedPublish first under the send's own time; install and onReconnect clear the record; /metrics and PublishFailures wired in cmd/dispatch/main.go; cmd/listener/api.go keeps #2508's change.
TestRunCountsADeniedSubjectOncePerRefusedMessage on two issues is required by per-issue order; assertions unchanged.

Fix 14170450: no race between flush result, reply and connection change; the flush goroutine never blocks and ends by the deadline; a flush denial is still reported; the test failed 2 of 2 against the old synchronous flush.
